I saved the best for last. The CASIO EF503D-1AV is a great watch at a great price. A review I wrote some months ago:

I have this Edifice model. This watch is, quite seriously, one of the greatest bargains of any kind that I have been lucky enough to stumble across.

The attention to detail and build quality (yes, I am actually talking about a CASIO) are staggering for a watch at this price-point. The bracelet alone is worth buying this watch for. Solid stainless steel with solid end links on a watch that goes for under eighty bucks? Yes, please.

The dial is lovely, as well. Matte black with three subdials (hours, minutes, small seconds) containing raised concentric circles that love to catch the light. Nice applied indices and a date window framed in silver complete the look. The tachymeter, although I never use it, looks nice and helps the Speedmaster vibe that the designers were going for.

The chrono buttons are nice and sturdy, as is everything else about this inexpensive little gem. I never thought that one could use the term "fit and finish" while talking about a CASIO, but you certainly can with this one.

Even the quartz movement is better than necessary. The Miyota 01S0 is not some 7-dollar crapfest. A replacement will run you $35. There are several areas where it would have been fairly easy for CASIO to take shortcuts/use cheaper materials, but they didn't. Even the hands on this beauty that tick line up perfectly with the tick-marks. Awesome.

I know that there are a lot of people here that will not have anything to do with quartz watches. That's a damn shame, because those people are robbing themselves of a very nice ownership experience. Well-proportioned, solid as a rock and insanely comfortable to wear (oh, that bracelet!), the CASIO Edifice EF503D-1AV is truly an example of a company giving the consumer an insane amout of quality for the dollar. It is one of my very favorite watches, and I certainly did not see that coming when I ordered it.

I guess I have to come up with one negative, and that is easy, as there is only one thing about this watch that I'd change. Everything is literally perfect except for the lume. It is so terrible, I just think of the watch as having none at all.

Wow. I guess I look like a crazy man, rambling on so about an $80 watch. I don't care.

Buy this watch. You'll thank me.
